brief:
Content creator Nolan Sumor recorded video footage inside a settlement market showing religious head coverings printed with an image of Donald Trump, Eye on Palestine reported. Settlers in the market interacted with and approved of the merchandise during the tour, with some examining the kippahs as Sumor documented the scene.

The video capture reveals a commercial market for political merchandise within Israeli settlements in the occupied West Bank. The Trump-printed head coverings were openly displayed and sold alongside other goods, drawing interest from shoppers who examined the items during their market visit.
